summary: Verification-only run for the reported 'Cross-origin request blocked' admin bug. Opened the public preview URL in a real browser, clicked Admin → Send verification code exactly once, then submitted 000000 exactly once. Bug is FIXED.
test_credentials: N/A — no login required for admin request-verification button test.
seed_data_creation: None. One real admin verification code email was sent as approved in the request.
context_for_next_testing_agent: CORS_ORIGINS in /app/backend/.env now includes both the preview.emergentagent.com and cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud hosts. server.py has no CORS-DEBUG debug print (confirmed grep count=0). Admin request-verification is rate-limited 3/15min and verify 6/10min per client host — reuse the previously captured cookie/code path sparingly.

verification_evidence.primary_click_result: POST /api/auth/admin/request-verification returned 200 (captured via page.on('response')); no red 'Cross-origin request blocked' banner; error text was empty string after click.
verification_evidence.ui_advance: data-testid=admin-code-input rendered and became visible immediately after the single click.
verification_evidence.optional_wrong_code: Submitting 000000 once returned 401 and the UI displayed 'Incorrect verification code' — confirms verify endpoint is also reachable cross-origin.
verification_evidence.backend_access_log: Latest entries for the browser request show 'POST /api/auth/admin/request-verification HTTP/1.1 200 OK' followed by 'POST /api/auth/admin/verify HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized'. All older 403 entries pre-date the CORS_ORIGINS fix.

rca of the issue: Browser Origin header at the Emergent preview URL is the cluster-12.preview.emergentcf.cloud host (the internal host the public preview URL is mapped to). Before the fix, CORS_ORIGINS in backend/.env only listed the public preview host, so the security middleware's origin check rejected same-domain-different-host browser POSTs with 403 (surfaced in the UI as 'Cross-origin request blocked'). Configuration-only fix: added the cluster-12 host to CORS_ORIGINS. Verified end-to-end in browser: 200 on request-verification, 401 on wrong-code verify, no 403, no CORS banner.
